Desktop development

DigiShelf Desktop .

A Windows library application that connects loans and returns to stock counts and reports.

View Project Folder

Project context

Visual Programming · Team of four

  • C# · WinForms
  • SQL Server
  • Crystal Reports

Operational needs

Checking out a book changes its availability. Returning it affects stock, the borrower’s history, and any overdue fines. Staff need to follow the same transaction from the member’s account to the inventory report.

Team contribution

I worked on this application as part of a four-person team. Members can search the catalogue, borrow or renew books, and look up past loans. Staff can manage books and member records and export data.

Data and reporting

The WinForms application uses ADO.NET to connect to SQL Server. Eleven tables support library operations. Four Crystal Reports cover inventory, loans, returns and fines, and member records.
